title: Ladder 8 · 50 new words + 30 hard ones
summary: Road to 2,000, set 1: the next 50 Road words (induō, tunica, sūmō, piscis, mūrus, umbra, collum, iaceō, stēlla, scaena…) in 5 scenes (morning, kitchen, walk, a long night, evening), each word heard 6+ times, plus your 30 stickiest hell words (quoniam, ideō, quidem, quīdam, tamen, īdem, tālis…) in clear sentences. Closing story of the whole day, then a quick-fire list of all 80 words. Free voice (IPA, v as v).
